title: Public profile
description: The marina profile published next to the booking page: position, contacts, opening hours, depths, services, photos and a simplified map. It never contains personal data or the occupancy of single berths.
localMode: This installation is not reachable from the internet: the profile is visible on the local network only.

missing.contact: at least one contact (phone, email or website)
missing.name: the marina name

invalid: Some fields are not valid: check the tabs of the form.

fields.vhfInvalid: Channels go from 1 to 88, at most four.
fields.computed: Empty: the computed value is used ({{n}}).

photos.hint: JPEG or PNG up to 8 MB, at most {{max}}. Photos are re-encoded without metadata (GPS position included).

sections.map: Show the simplified map (no berth codes, no occupancy)
sections.poi: Points of interest on the map
sections.poiHint: Map coordinates in metres from the top-left corner.
sections.pricesHint: No active transit price list has a publishable price table: enable it in the price list settings to show it.
sections.occupancy: Show the free berths tonight (only the number per category)
sections.categoriesHint: The page shows how many berths of each category are free, never which ones.
